body.purpose: All prose: bio, descriptions, achievement text.

label.purpose: Station numbers, dates, meta lines (JetBrains Mono).

reading.purpose: Quantified before-to-after measurements (JetBrains Mono, one step larger than Label).

motion.name: section-fade
motion.value: opacity + 12px directional slide, 0.35s ease-out, once per viewport entry
motion.purpose: Restrained entrance for sections and log rows — no bounce, no overshoot.

motion.name: theme-transition
motion.purpose: Light/dark toggle crossfade; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Station Label
components.description: Monospace station number in Signal Blue followed by a plain Ink heading; replaces every section header.
components.css: .ds-station { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 24px; } .ds-station-num { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #2563EB; } .ds-station-title { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #18181B; margin: 0; }

components.name: Reading Line
components.description: Plain-text before-to-after measurement; the arrow carries Signal Blue, everything else stays Ink.
components.css: .ds-reading { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: #18181B; } .ds-reading-arrow { color: #2563EB; margin: 0 6px; } .ds-reading-context { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; color: #71717A; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Rounded-full pill — the system's one rounding exception, used for skills/tech tags only.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #E4E4E7; color: #71717A; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Log Row
components.description: Two-column label + content row separated by a single hairline rule; no card, no shadow.

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Plain text nav link; active state turns Signal Blue, no pill or background.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #71717A; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #18181B; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #2563EB; }

narrative.overview:
Wahyu's actual craft is measurement: turning chaotic, real-world systems into precise, recorded numbers — a RAG chatbot's response time, a fraud model's transaction volume, a retail dataset's row count. The site takes that literally. It reads like a field surveyor's measurement log, not a portfolio built from the same Inter-and-blue-links template every minimalist developer site already runs. Section headers become station numbers ("STA 01"). Quantified outcomes are set as readings — a plain "before → after" in monospace, never a fake progress bar or sparkline standing in for a number that doesn't exist. Everything else stays exactly as restrained as the brief asked: plain white ground, black ink, one accent color, no cards, no shadows, no glass.

The palette is almost monochrome on purpose: white/near-black carries the page, and Signal Blue appears only where something is actively being measured or acted on. Depth doesn't exist here; separation comes from thin hairline rules and generous whitespace. Dark mode is a plain, honest inversion, not a second themed world.
keyCharacteristics: Station-number labels ("STA 01", "STA 02"...) replace section headers, in monospace, colored with the one accent
Real quantified outcomes are set as plain-text "before → after" readings, never as a decorative stat widget
One accent (Signal Blue) used only for labels, links, and active states — never a background fill
Inter for all prose and headings; JetBrains Mono for every number, date, coordinate, and reading
Flat by design: hairline rules and whitespace do the separating work that cards and shadows do elsewhere
Plain white ground — no background texture
A wider two-column log-row layout (label column + content column) replaces the old narrow single centered column

rules.name: The One-Mark Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue marks exactly one thing at a time — the station label of the section currently in view, an active link, a reading's arrow. It never fills a background or repeats decoratively.

rules.name: The Measurement-Only-Mono Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only where the content is a real measurement, date, or coordinate — never as a "technical" costume on ordinary prose.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing in this system casts a shadow. If a boundary is needed, it is a 1px hairline rule; if separation is needed, it is whitespace.

dos: Do mark exactly one thing at a time with Signal Blue — a label, a link, a reading arrow.
Do keep JetBrains Mono reserved for genuine measurements, dates, and coordinates.
Do separate every section and entry with a hairline rule and whitespace, never a card or shadow.
Do render a real quantified outcome as a plain before → after reading; omit it entirely where no real number exists.
Do keep the station-label device as the one recurring signature element across every section.
Do keep the page background plain white — no grid, no texture.
donts: Don't add a card, border-box, or shadow anywhere — this system has none.
Don't invent a stat bar, progress ring, or sparkline to represent a number — set the real number as text or don't show one.
Don't introduce a second accent color; the system has exactly one.
Don't round anything beyond the one pill-chip exception — no rounded cards, no circular badges.
